rationale: BI-7BCC87BB. Founder decision DI-FFD78D222548 chose envelope-shared-buttons over link-to-needs-you and v1-adapter: the supervisor agent card shows the coworker's newest pending item. A pending approval request (envelope) gets the same Authorize / Decline as Needs-you and the chat card (EnvelopeDecisionButtons) posted to the envelope routes; an admin who is not the owner gets the on-behalf control from DI-18258852EB33; anyone else sees who it waits for and no control. A legacy proposal keeps its v1 endpoint until PR-C. No new verb, route or field type; the count label becomes 'Pending approvals'. --dpf-* tokens and approvals catalog copy only.
